headline: Sensex Surges 685 Points as Nifty Reclaims 22,700; Pharma and Oil & Gas Lead Market Gains

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Sensex surged 685 points, marking a strong recovery from the previous week's record bear run.
Investor sentiment was lifted by the government's proposed five-pronged reform plan for the GST system.
The Union Cabinet's approval of a ₹10,000-crore SME growth fund provided a boost to the manufacturing sector.
Markets showed resilience and jumped over 500 points early in the day despite recent FII selling pressure.
whatHappening: The Nifty 50 closed at 22,776, successfully reclaiming the 22,700 level during Tuesday's trading session.
Mphasis announced an extension of its partnership with Social Security Scotland to support their benefits platform.
The GST Council is preparing a major overhaul to be discussed at its upcoming meeting on October 8.
Pharma and Oil & Gas shares were the top performers, contributing significantly to the market's upward momentum.
summary:
Indian markets rallied on October 6, with the Sensex gaining 685 points and Nifty closing at 22,776.
The surge was supported by outperforming Pharma and Oil & Gas sectors and a new ₹10,000-crore SME fund.
Mphasis was in focus after extending its partnership with Social Security Scotland to support their benefits platform.
